description: Speak text in a project's cloned voice (via lab_voice_clone) — SYNCHRONOUS, returns a ready audio_url, no job_id. The voice house is whichever one cloned this voice; you do not pick it here. Consent-sensitive like the clone itself: only speak text you have the right to put in that voice's mouth.

get_cost.description: Price this call instead of running it: returns the estimate and the balance, charges nothing, produces no audio. Worth doing before a long passage, because both houses bill by the size of the text, not per run — so the same tool can cost wildly different amounts depending on what you hand it. The rates behind the estimate are not repeated here; lab_list_models carries them.

nur_eigene_daten.description: Only for a model that sends inputs to China or a US recipient without a documented basis, when the step carries images, clips, voices or faces. Means: this material shows or contains no real person other than the human using this account. Set it ONLY after the human has said exactly that for THIS step; never assume it, never reuse it for the next step. Not needed when the human has declared this material in the FilmLab app: the backend reads that declaration, also for material derived from it; only the app can store one. An LK reference, a licensed likeness or another person's agreement does not replace it. Without it the backend refuses with drittland_dritte_gesperrt before any charge; then use a non-gated model or text only.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

provider.description: Cross-check, not a choice: the house that cloned this voice is the one that speaks with it, because a voice id from one house means nothing to the other. Pass it only to assert what you believe the voice is; a mismatch is refused before anything is charged. Omit it and the stored voice decides. Which house a voice belongs to: lab_list_voices. What each house can do: lab_list_models.

text.description: The line(s) to speak in this voice.

voice_id.description: A cloned voice's id (lab_cloned_voices.id, from lab_voice_clone or lab_list_voices) — positive integer as string, NOT the raw provider voice id.

name: lab_voice_tts
title: Speak in Cloned Voice
